label: sparse conjunction: early copy steps re-reading r/p (often before f/x) and post-y original steps
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.03% of steps). About 70% of activation mass is in the copy phase at recall_idx 1-2 (the first one or two re-fed tokens). It is enriched for inputs r/p/f/s, outputs f/x/d/m, short sequences (L=3-5) and sequences with no digits. The other ~25% is original-phase steps at t>=3, typically shortly after a y (often alongside x/h). No predicate reached F1 above 0.15: recent-y/h predicates reach about 0.6 recall at about 0.1% precision, and the narrow r/p->f/x copy-step predicate gets about 0.14 precision and recall. Magnitude is narrow (mean 0.12, max 0.22). It never fires at t<=2 or at copy positions beyond recall_idx 3, and it does not fire once copying has gone wrong.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=p (+5.46), orig1=f (+3.82), prev_tok=y (+3.71), orig0=f (+3.58), orig0=r (+3.32), orig1=x (+3.17). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-3.33), orig2=2 (-3.11), phase=2 (-2.17), orig_idx=-1 (-0.83).
